title.description: Job title applied for as written on the resume. Extract verbatim in Vietnamese if the resume is in Vietnamese.

level.description: Classify level based on experience: junior (<2 years), mid-level (2-5 years), senior (>5 years), leadership (manager/team-lead/director), or unknown.

total_years_experience.description: Calculated total years of working experience across all jobs (from earliest to latest job end date).

seniority_summary.description: Detailed sentence summarizing total years worked and breakdown of experience by field/role (e.g., '4 years total experience: 2.5 years in C&B, 1.5 years in Recruitment').

self_evaluation.description: Personal summary or career objective section verbatim. Extract verbatim in Vietnamese, preserving all Vietnamese diacritics and tone marks.

skills_and_specialties.description: Extract maximum 20 key technical skills and competencies. DO NOT extract more than 20 skills. Format each skill with a descriptive sentence detailing experience level and context.

language.description: Language name verbatim (e.g., Tiếng Anh, Tiếng Việt, English, Vietnamese).

proficiency.description: Proficiency level verbatim as written (e.g., Thành thạo, Trung cấp, Native).

name.description: Certificate name verbatim (e.g., IELTS, TOEIC, HSK).
Professional certification name verbatim in Vietnamese or English (e.g., PMP, AWS Certified Solutions Architect).

company_name.description: Company name verbatim as written on the resume.

company_description.description: Description of the company verbatim in Vietnamese if written in Vietnamese.

position.description: Job title or position verbatim. Extract in Vietnamese if written in Vietnamese.

duration.description: Employment period (start date - end date) as written.

responsibilities.description: A comprehensive list of every single duty, responsibility, and achievement verbatim. Extract ALL responsibilities in Vietnamese, preserving all accents/diacritics. Do not summarize or omit any. Create a separate string element for each task/duty.

location.description: Residence or location verbatim (e.g., Hà Nội, TP. Hồ Chí Minh, Da Nang).

university_name.description: Institution or university name verbatim (e.g., Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội, Hanoi University).

degree.description: Degree verbatim (e.g., Kỹ sư, Cử nhân, Thạc sĩ, Bachelor, Engineer).

field_of_study.description: Field of study verbatim in Vietnamese if written in Vietnamese.

description.description: Project description and results verbatim in Vietnamese if written in Vietnamese.
